jobs.title: Chief Executive Officer
jobs.description:
Ziarat is Hiring: Chief Executive Officer (CEO)

About Ziarat

Ziarat is building modern financial infrastructure to make global money movement simpler, more accessible, and more connected for individuals and businesses.

Our platform brings together global payments, multi-currency financial services, foreign exchange, and digital assets into one integrated experience, designed to help people and businesses participate more efficiently in the global economy.

Our mission is simple:

Build the Future of Global Finance.

We are now looking for an exceptional Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to lead Ziarat from its early stage through fundraising, regulatory development, market launch, revenue generation, and international expansion.

About the Role

This is a high-ownership founding leadership position for an experienced fintech operator, founder, CEO, COO, GM, or senior financial-services executive who has demonstrated the ability to build and scale companies.

The CEO will be responsible for the company's overall strategy and execution, with particular emphasis on:

- Fundraising and investor relations
- Fintech licensing and regulatory strategy
- Banking and payment-provider partnerships
- Business development and revenue generation
- Operational execution and team building
- Market launch and international expansion
- Strategic partnerships and corporate development

The ideal candidate should be capable of helping Ziarat progress from early-stage company → funded fintech → licensed operations → revenue → global scale.

Key Responsibilities

Fundraising

- Lead Ziarat's fundraising strategy and investor outreach.
- Build relationships with VCs, angel investors, family offices, strategic investors, and financial institutions.
- Lead investor meetings, negotiations, due diligence, and financing processes.
- Help establish a strong long-term capital strategy.

Licensing & Regulatory

- Develop and execute the company's licensing and regulatory roadmap.
- Work with legal, compliance, banking, and regulatory partners across relevant markets.
- Establish appropriate KYC/AML, risk, compliance, and governance frameworks.

Banking & Payments

- Develop relationships with banks, payment institutions, fintech infrastructure providers, and strategic financial partners.
- Identify and negotiate partnerships required to launch and scale Ziarat's financial services.

Growth & Revenue

- Develop Ziarat's go-to-market strategy.
- Build revenue-generating partnerships and distribution channels.
- Identify high-potential markets and customer segments.
- Establish measurable growth and revenue targets.

Leadership & Operations

- Build and lead a high-performance executive and operating team.
- Establish company priorities, KPIs, budgets, and operating processes.
- Ensure product, compliance, operations, sales, and finance teams execute against the company's strategy.

International Expansion

- Develop Ziarat's international market-entry strategy.
- Build strategic relationships across emerging and developed financial markets.
- Lead the company toward sustainable international growth.

Required Qualifications

- Proven executive-level experience as a CEO, COO, GM, founder, or senior fintech/financial-services executive.
- Demonstrated track record of successfully raising capital for a startup, fintech, or technology company — mandatory.
- Strong existing network across VCs, angels, strategic investors, financial institutions, or family offices.
- Significant experience in fintech, payments, financial services, digital finance, or related technology.
- Practical understanding of financial licensing, regulatory frameworks, KYC/AML, compliance, and risk management.
- Experience establishing banking, payment, or financial infrastructure partnerships.
- Proven business-development and revenue-generation experience.
- Strong financial understanding, including financial modeling, budgeting, capital allocation, and unit economics.
- Experience developing and executing go-to-market and international expansion strategies.
- Strong negotiation, communication, stakeholder-management, and decision-making skills.
- Ability to build teams, manage senior leaders, and operate effectively in an early-stage environment.
- Strong understanding of global payments, FX, multi-currency financial services, and/or digital assets.

What We Are Looking For

We are not looking for a traditional corporate executive who only manages an established organization.

We are looking for a builder and operator who can actively help create the company, raise capital, establish strategic partnerships, navigate licensing, build the team, generate revenue, and scale Ziarat internationally.

A candidate with a history of founding, scaling, fundraising, or leading a high-growth fintech or financial-services company will be strongly preferred.

Compensation

Equity-based initially, with the opportunity for salary, equity, and performance incentives as Ziarat secures funding and begins generating revenue.

This is a high-ownership opportunity to join Ziarat at an early stage and help shape the company's long-term direction.

Ziarat — Build the Future of Global Finance.

jobs.title: Director of Marketing and Communications
jobs.description:
Columbia Journalism School (
www.journalism.columbia.edu
) seeks a strategic and innovative Director of Marketing and Communications to expand the School’s reach, engage new audiences, and strengthen the visibility of its academic and professional programs.

Reporting to the Chief of Staff, the Director of Marketing and Communications will lead the development and execution of an integrated marketing strategy for the Columbia University Journalism School. The position will play a central role in expanding the School’s reach, strengthening its market position, and identifying and engaging new audiences for its degree programs, professional and executive education offerings, and other strategic initiatives.

A primary focus of the role will be enrollment marketing. Working closely with Admissions and Financial Aid, the Director of Marketing and Communications will develop strategies to increase awareness of Columbia Journalism School among prospective students, generate qualified prospects, and grow the pipeline for the School’s academic programs. The successful candidate will bring particular expertise in identifying and reaching audiences who may not already be considering graduate journalism education and translating the School’s distinctive strengths into compelling campaigns that drive interest and enrollment. The position will complement and amplify the School’s existing recruitment efforts by bringing dedicated marketing expertise in audience development, market research, positioning, campaign strategy, and lead generation.

The Director will also provide marketing strategy and support for other School priorities, including professional and executive education programs, alumni and development initiatives, and other emerging programs. The position will work across departments to understand their goals, identify audiences, and develop effective approaches to reaching them.

The Director will supervise the Senior Digital Communications Specialist and help integrate marketing strategy with the School’s digital communications, content, social media, website, and storytelling efforts. Working as part of a small, collaborative team, the Director must be equally comfortable in setting and executing strategy and contribute directly to campaigns, content, digital platforms, and other marketing and communications work as needed. The position will establish goals and metrics for marketing initiatives, assess performance and return on investment, and use data and experimentation to continuously improve the School’s approach.

For additional information about the responsibilities and requirements of this position, and/or to submit your application for consideration, please visit: http://opportunities.columbia.edu/cw/en-us/job/559460?lApplicationSubSourceID=

Columbia University is an equal opportunity employer / disability / veteran and is committed to the hiring of qualifiedlocal residents.

jobs.description:
Overview

Looking for a career that makes a difference every day?

Discover a rewarding career at Enhabit Home Health & Hospice, one of the nation’s largest home-based care providers. Consistently recognized as a great place to work, Enhabit delivers exceptional care and fosters a collaborative culture that supports professional growth and ongoing development.

With strong organizational stability, a commitment to excellence, and careers rooted in purpose, Enhabit empowers team members to build forward-moving careers while expanding what’s possible for care in the home.

The Enhabit Advantage

Enhabit offers competitive benefits designed to support well-being and help employees thrive in every stage of their careers. Eligible employees receive:

Generous paid time off for full-time employees
401(k) matching
Medical, dental and vision coverage
Supplemental insurance options
Flexible spending accounts
Incentive bonus opportunities
Continuing education and scholarship opportunities

Responsibilities

Serve as the local chief executive agent. Lead the local provider(s) in a better way to care for the community in which it serves, and contribute to the overall success of the company. Ensure the execution of operations are completed daily. Manage operations, services, personnel performance, and office management ongoing.

Qualifications

Must have an associate degree in a health related field and two years' as a manager or supervisor.
Must not have been employed in the last year as an administrator with another operation at the time any enforcement action was taken against the business; further described in the company compliance policies.
Must have intermediate demonstrated technology skills, including operation of a mobile device.

Education And Experience, Preferred

A licensed physician, registered nurse, licensed social worker, licensed therapist, or a licensed nursing home administrator is preferred.
Previous experience in a home health care or hospice program is preferred.

Education and experience, state specific

ALASKA No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

ALABAMA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

ARKANSAS No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

ARIZONA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

COLORADO No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

CONNECTICUT

A master degree in nursing with an active license to practice nursing in the state and at least one year of

supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility program which included care of the sick; or a

master degree in public health or administration with a concentration of study in health services administration, and at least one year of supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or a baccalaureate degree in nursing with an active license to practice nursing in the state and at least two years supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or a baccalaureate degree in administration with a concentration of study in health services administration and at least two years supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or a physician licensed to practice medicine and surgery in the state of Connecticut who has had at least one year supervisory or administrative experience in a health care facility or program which included care of the sick; or employment as the administrator of a home health care agency in this state as of January 1, 1981, who has been so employed continuously for the five years immediately preceding January 1, 1981; or continuous employment as an administrator of a home health care agency as of January 1, 1979 ; except that on and after January 1, 1986, no person shall be employed as an administrator of a home health care agency pursuant to this subdivision unless such person additionally meets one of the requirements above. Must be administrator for only one agency.

DELAWARE No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

FLORIDA

Must be administrator for only one agency; or manage up to five agencies located within one agency geographic service area or within immediate contiguous counties and have identical controlling interest.

GEORGIA No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

IDAHO no additional state specified education, experience requirements

ILLINOIS No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

INDIANA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

KANSAS No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

KENTUCKY no additional state specified education, experience requirements

LOUISIANA

Must be a licensed physician, licensed registered nurse, a social worker with a master's degree, or a college

graduate with a bachelor's degree, and have three years management experience in health care service

delivery. Any person who was employed by a licensed Louisiana hospice as the administrator as of December 20, 1998 is exempt from these requirements as long as he/she remains employed by that hospice as the administrator. If the hospice is acquired, sold to or merged into another legal entity, this exemption still stands.

MARYLAND

Must possess education in health services or administration, evidenced by being a physician; registered nurse; or college graduate with a bachelor degree in a health-related field. Must also have at least one year of supervisory experience in hospital, home health, or public health program management.

MASSACHUSETTS

Must have two years of relevant experience in the health care, human services, or related fields, which shall

include at least one year of supervisory or administrative experience.

MISSISSIPPI No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

MISSOURI no additional state specified education, experience requirements

MONTANA No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

NEVADA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

NEW MEXICO No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

NORTH CAROLINA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

OHIO No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

OKLAHOMA

Must possess an Oklahoma administrator license. Must complete eight continuing education units per year.

OREGON No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

PENNSYLVANIA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

RHODE ISLAND No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

SOUTH CAROLINA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

TENNESSE No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

TEXAS

Must comply with Texas state regulation 97.259 a-g requiring 24 hours of training in the first 12 months if a first time administrator. Must have documented completion of a minimum of 12 clock hours per year at a health administration seminar or through an approved provider.

UTAH No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

VIRGINIA no additional state specified education, experience requirements

WASHINGTON No Additional State Specified Education, Experience Requirements

WYOMING no additional state specified education, experience requirements

Requirements

Must possess a valid state driver license
Must maintain automobile liability insurance as required by law
Must maintain dependable transportation in good working condition
Must be able to safely drive an automobile in all types of weather conditions

We are committed to a work environment that supports, encourages and motivates all individuals without discrimination on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age, disability, national or ethnic origin, military service status, citizenship, genetic information, or other protected characteristic.
